domain(person,[cassidy,ayla,angie,superstar]).

% If Cassidy has an advanced degree, then she works in research.
axiom(s1, rule([has_advanced_degree(cassidy)], works_in_research(cassidy))).
% If Ayla can solve complex problems, then she has a creative mind and collaborates with others.
axiom(s2, rule([can_solve_complex_problems(ayla)], and(has_creative_mind(ayla), collaborates_with_others(ayla)))).
% Ayla either pursues innovation or engineers new technologies.
axiom(s3, or(pursues_innovation(ayla), engineers_new_technologies(ayla))).
% Ayla does not receive an award.
axiom(s4, not(receives_award(ayla))).
% If Ayla is inquisitive, then she is either passionate about discovery or seeks knowledge (but not both).
axiom(s5, rule([is_inquisitive(ayla)], xor(passionate_about_discovery(ayla), seeks_knowledge(ayla)))).
% If Ayla enjoys learning, then she is passionate about discovery and mentors others.
axiom(s6, rule([enjoys_learning(ayla)], and(passionate_about_discovery(ayla), mentors_others(ayla)))).
% If Ayla pursues innovation, then she either publishes papers or receives an award (or both).
axiom(s7, rule([pursues_innovation(ayla)], or(publishes_papers(ayla), receives_award(ayla)))).
% Ayla thinks outside the box.
axiom(s8, thinks_outside_the_box(ayla)).
% If Ayla thinks critically, then she has a creative mind.
axiom(s9, rule([thinks_critically(ayla)], has_creative_mind(ayla))).
% Angie thinks outside the box.
axiom(s10, thinks_outside_the_box(angie)).
% If Cassidy thinks outside the box, then she will design new products.
axiom(s11, rule([thinks_outside_the_box(cassidy)], designs_new_products(cassidy))).
% If Ayla has a creative mind, then she either designs new products or engineers new technologies, but not both.
axiom(s12, rule([has_creative_mind(ayla)], xor(designs_new_products(ayla), engineers_new_technologies(ayla)))).
% If Ayla excels in science, then she will engineer new technologies.
axiom(s13, rule([excels_in_science(ayla)], engineers_new_technologies(ayla))).
% Ayla collaborates with others.
axiom(s14, collaborates_with_others(ayla)).
% Cassidy can solve complex problems.
axiom(s15, can_solve_complex_problems(cassidy)).
% If Ayla is passionate about discovery, then she has an advanced degree and publishes papers.
axiom(s16, rule([passionate_about_discovery(ayla)], and(has_advanced_degree(ayla), publishes_papers(ayla)))).
% If Ayla thinks outside the box, then she will design new products.
axiom(s17, rule([thinks_outside_the_box(ayla)], designs_new_products(ayla))).
% Cassidy is inquisitive.
axiom(s18, is_inquisitive(cassidy)).
% If Angie can solve complex problems, then she has a creative mind and collaborates with others.
axiom(s19, rule([can_solve_complex_problems(angie)], and(has_creative_mind(angie), collaborates_with_others(angie)))).
% Ayla does not seek knowledge.
axiom(s20, not(seeks_knowledge(ayla))).
% Ayla is inquisitive.
axiom(s21, is_inquisitive(ayla)).
% If Angie has a creative mind, then she either designs new products or engineers new technologies, but not both.
axiom(s22, rule([has_creative_mind(angie)], xor(designs_new_products(angie), engineers_new_technologies(angie)))).
% Superstar does not seek knowledge.
axiom(s23, not(seeks_knowledge(superstar))).
% If Ayla has an advanced degree, then she works in research.
axiom(s24, rule([has_advanced_degree(ayla)], works_in_research(ayla))).
% Everyone who values progress either pursues innovation or mentors others (or both).
axiom(s25, forall(var(x,person), implies(values_progress(var(x)), or(pursues_innovation(var(x)), mentors_others(var(x)))))).
% If Superstar pursues innovation, then she either publishes papers or receives an award (or both).
axiom(s26, rule([pursues_innovation(superstar)], or(publishes_papers(superstar), receives_award(superstar)))).
% If Superstar is inquisitive, then she is either passionate about discovery or seeks knowledge (but not both).
axiom(s27, rule([is_inquisitive(superstar)], xor(passionate_about_discovery(superstar), seeks_knowledge(superstar)))).
% Ayla can solve complex problems.
axiom(s28, can_solve_complex_problems(ayla)).
